allgender.hintText: This helps in opening up the conversation and shows you are polite and professional too! The interviewer may even have a positive impression on you as you appear confident and well-prepared for the interview.

option.optionText: Hello Thendral, How are you?
Hello mam/sir, I am fine, How are you?

allgender.quetionTitle: Test the Device and Technology

option.optionText: It is recommended to take the interview on your laptops/desktops to avoid any disturbance

If you have no choice but to take the interview on your mobile phones, put your phone on Do not Disturb mode or the mode which will avoid calls or messages interrupting and distracting you during your interview process
If the organisation has suggested specific software, familiarise yourself with the software

Ensure the microphone and speakers are working and that the internet connection supports high-quality live video by making or receiving a test call from a friend or family member, preferably in the same platform to practice using the software
Use a professional screen name that interviewers can easily recognise, not fancy names that you use for your Instagram or snapchat!

allgender.quetionTitle: Practice

option.optionText: Practice your interview technique on camera. Ask a friend or family member to give you feedback on the location, quality of video and lightings
Let them ask you a few of the interview questions you are prepared with over the video call. Practice responding to questions naturally and letting the interviewer finish before speaking
Practice listening carefully, speaking carefully and leaving the call after they finish since you may experience slight delay in video calls
The more you practice, the more confident you will be for the actual call

The best tip is for you to thoroughly prepare for the first question which is the typical question in any interview - “Tell me about yourself”. Practice the response for this question so you have a very good start.

allgender.quetionTitle: Sometimes the interviewer may not necessarily start with ‘tell me about yourself’. How to start the interview then?
allgender.hintText: This is how you redirect your question to the answer you are already prepared with, so you can build a good first impression with your interviewer

option.optionText: So Thendral, I have looked at your profile and see that you are interested in playing football. So, tell me why this job is important for you and you are not looking at a career in sports?

Thank you mam for the question! Definitely my passion is to play football, however to build a career in sports is not what I am looking at. I would definitely want to build my career in the field of xxx and shine. Let me first tell you about myself… (and talk about the answer you already prepared and practiced)

allgender.quetionTitle: Your Location

option.optionText: Be mindful of choosing a quiet room with minimal background noise and no distractions.
Adequate lighting is a must, preferably natural. The light should fall on your face and should not be behind you as it ensures showing your face clearly to the interviewer
Try your best to chose a white wall behind so that no one is walking around behind you
Inform people at home to avoid making noise as this is an interview to decide your future
Wear appropriate clothing and light colours to make you look professional.

allgender.quetionTitle: Take Notes

option.optionText: The best way to take notes during an interview is with a notebook and pen and not on your computer. Do not type anything on the computer during the interview process as the interviewer might think you are searching the internet for responses
Alert your interviewer that you are taking notes as they should not think you are disinterested

Do not write too much on the notebook. The best thing to do would be to use your notebook to make notes twice or thrice at best during the interview process as it gives the impression that you are attentive and at the same time taking notes of critical inputs. Like for ex. If you ask the interviewer how many employees are there in the organisation or what are the different industries the organisation is venturing into, these are questions for which you can write down the answers for your future reference.

allgender.quetionTitle: On the interview Day!

option.optionText: Its best to be fully ready 30-45 minutes before the interview and login atleast 10 minutes before your interview.
Do all the technology checks, internet connectivity and backup, lightings and a gentle nudge to your family to not cause any disturbance.
Opening your online platform a few minutes before the interview shows professional courtesy as well as gives you to fix any last minute issues
Wear clean professional attire as this will also help you focus and give you confidence.
Take care of the hair and groom yourself well enough so you appear your professional best on camera!

allgender.quetionTitle: DO’S

option.optionValue: Consider wearing earbuds to reduce noise and distractionst
Have backups in case technology challenges come up

allgender.quetionTitle: DON’TS

option.optionText: Don’t multitask
Don’t forget to mute notifications
Don’t rely solely on notes
Don’t Neglect your appearance
Don’t rush through your answers
Don’t interrupt interviewer
Don’t forget about non-verbal cues
Don’t use inappropriate background
Don’t be late
